evals.prompt: Evaluate CoPaw AI assistant for integration into our NEXUS ecosystem. We need it to handle student support queries and route complex issues to human tutors. Assess compatibility and integration feasibility.
evals.expected_output: A comprehensive evaluation of CoPaw covering API compatibility, feature assessment, integration architecture, and a feasibility recommendation for student support use case
assertions: Response must assess CoPaw's API capabilities and protocol compatibility with NEXUS ecosystem standards
Response must evaluate whether CoPaw can handle the specific student support use case including query routing
Response must provide a clear feasibility recommendation with identified integration risks and blockers

evals.prompt: We want to integrate ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini APIs into our ecosystem as pluggable tutoring backends. Design the integration architecture that allows switching between them.
evals.expected_output: An integration architecture with abstraction layer design, API adapter patterns, failover logic, and configuration for pluggable LLM backends
assertions: Response must design an abstraction layer that normalizes the APIs of all three providers behind a common interface
Response must address differences in API protocols, rate limits, and response formats across providers
Response must include failover and fallback logic for provider outages or degraded performance

evals.prompt: Assess the Intercom Fin AI agent for customer support integration. We need to know if it can handle our EdTech-specific queries and what the integration effort would be.
evals.expected_output: An evaluation of Intercom Fin covering EdTech domain fit, API integration requirements, customization capabilities, and total integration effort estimate
assertions: Response must evaluate Intercom Fin's ability to handle education-specific terminology and query types
Response must detail the API integration requirements including authentication, webhooks, and data flow
Response must estimate integration effort in developer-hours or sprints with key milestones

evals.prompt: A new AI agent marketplace (SkillsMP) offers 500+ pre-built education agents. Evaluate 3 of their top-rated agents for potential import into NEXUS: MathTutor Pro, LanguageCoach, and StudyPlanner.
evals.expected_output: A comparative evaluation of 3 marketplace agents covering capability fit, quality assessment, NEXUS compatibility, and import recommendation
assertions: Response must evaluate each agent individually against NEXUS ecosystem requirements and standards
Response must assess skill quality and coverage for each agent's claimed domain
Response must provide import recommendations with specific compatibility issues to resolve for each agent

evals.prompt: Our integration of an external grading assistant is producing incomplete recommendations -- it only covers multiple choice but not essay or project grading. Diagnose the completeness gap and propose fixes.
evals.expected_output: A gap analysis of the incomplete integration with root cause identification, missing capability mapping, and remediation plan to achieve full grading coverage
assertions: Response must identify the specific capability gaps in the external assistant's coverage (essay grading, project evaluation)
Response must diagnose whether the gap is in the external tool's capabilities or in the integration configuration
Response must propose actionable fixes to achieve complete grading coverage, whether through configuration, supplementary tools, or custom development

should_trigger: Evaluate CoPaw for integration into our NEXUS ecosystem
Design an architecture to integrate multiple LLM providers as pluggable backends
Assess Intercom Fin for customer support in our EdTech platform
Evaluate marketplace agents for import into our ecosystem
Our external grading assistant integration is incomplete, diagnose the issue
should_not_trigger: Set up a headless browser fleet for web auditing
Build a digital twin simulation of our production infrastructure
Design anomaly detection rules for our SIEM
What pricing model should we use for our AaaS product?
Analyze cognitive load on our student dashboard interface
